card.summary: No published per-wiki storage cap; per-file ceiling is 100 MB (live siteinfo). Free, ad-supported; paid tiers exist for custom domains.

free_tier.stated: No published per-wiki storage cap; per-file ceiling is 100 MB (live siteinfo). Free, ad-supported; paid tiers exist for custom domains.

egress.terms: No egress meter; images served from `images.shoutwiki.com`.

record.tooling: Standard MediaWiki Action API (1.43.6) + Pywikibot. No rclone backend.
record.chaining: 100 MB/file x unlimited files x unlimited free wikis. Per-file cap is 10x Fandom's.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: 100 MB (104,857,600 B, from siteinfo). request-rate: the wiki HTML and the Action API are behind an Anubis proof-of-work challenge. A POST to `/w/api.php` returned the 'Making sure you're not a bot!' page instead of JSON, so programmatic access needs a PoW-capable client. Retention: no expiry published.
record.reliability_note: Read path splits: the file CDN (`images.shoutwiki.com`) answers plainly (probe: 200, 12,472 B, real PNG 150x150) while the API is Anubis-gated. Browse/upload programmatically is the blocker, not retrieval.

evidence.proved: probe: GET (via fetch proxy) -> 200, MediaWiki 1.43.6, maxuploadsize = 104857600
probe: GET -> 200, 12,472 bytes, PNG 150x150 — read path open
probe: POST (action=upload) -> 200 but body is the Anubis PoW interstitial, not JSON
